_why: The one project registry (bar-raise architecture-01, 2026-09-22). It was hand-kept in four places with four different memberships and four different field sets, so adding or retiring a project meant editing several files from memory and the status page had quietly been missing five of them for weeks.
_how: scripts/update-project-pages.mjs and scripts/check-page-prose-staleness.mjs read this file directly. The two browser pages cannot import it, because this site has no build step and every page is self-contained by convention, so scripts/stamp-project-registry.mjs writes the list into each of them between REGISTRY markers and scripts/check-project-registry.mjs fails the release when a stamped copy has drifted. Edit this file, run the stamper, commit both.

_fields.id: the dashboard identifier, and the status/data/<id>.json filename
_fields.slug: the URL segment under /projects/, absent when the project has no public page
_fields.hue: the dashboard's colour for this project
_fields.usageOnly: true when the project reports tokens and cost but publishes no status card
_fields.retired: the date it stopped, absent while it runs
_fields.stalled: the date it was stalled, absent while it runs; D81 stalled six on 2026-09-22
_fields.blurb: the homepage's one-line description, absent when the project has no public page
_fields.ld: the structured-data type for the homepage's hasPart enumeration
